spec: A 1-of-2 evenly presented randomizer FL_2 has two arms: FL_3 shows block BL_alpha (text-only vignette QID10), FL_4 shows block BL_beta (text-only vignette QID11). Then everyone sees BL_1 with the same outcome QID1. Each block is one page. Block ids are researcher-side identifiers and must not reach the respondent model.
